t: A Texas Instruments radio chip that runs many Zigbee smart home sticks.
steps: Buy a CC2652R coordinator stick or a TI LaunchPad board from a distributor such as DigiKey.
Download the free Z-Stack coordinator firmware from the Koenkk Z-Stack firmware page.
Install the open cc2538-bsl flashing tool on your computer.
Hold the stick's bootloader button as you plug it in. Then flash the firmware.
Plug the stick into the computer running Home Assistant or Zigbee2MQTT.
Add the stick as your Zigbee coordinator in the app settings.
Pair your first Zigbee sensor or bulb and watch it appear on the dashboard.
